description: HAL quadrature encoder: TIM4 encoder mode 3 on PB6 (A) / PB7 (B) with pull-ups and input filter, prints 'enc=<n>' on every change
expect: 72 MHz; USART1 PA9 115200 8N1. TIM4 in encoder mode 3 (SMS = 011): every edge of A (PB6) and of B (PB7) counts, up when A leads B, down when B leads A (RM0008 Table 87: 4 counts per quadrature cycle); inputs PB6/PB7 with internal pull-ups, IC1F = IC2F = 15 (an edge must hold 256 timer clocks = 3.6 us, shorter pulses are ignored); ARR 65535. Boot: 'enc=0\r\n'. The main loop polls CNT as a signed 16-bit position and prints 'enc=<position>\r\n' for every change; it sleeps in __WFI() between SysTick interrupts, so a change is reported within 1 ms (first byte 0.09-1.2 ms after the edge). From rest (A = B = 1): A low, B low, A high, B high -> enc=1, 2, 3, 4; B low, A low, B high, A high -> enc=-1, -2, -3, -4.

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
PB6, PB7: push-button to GND (encoder contacts A and B, common to GND)

scenarios.name: one detent forward (A leads B) counts up four times
one detent backward (B leads A) counts down four times
a 2 us contact bounce is filtered out
